plugins.name: OpenRGB
plugins.description: Mainboards, graphics cards, RAM, keyboards, mice, coolers and fans through an OpenRGB server. Covers ASUS Aura, Gigabyte RGB Fusion, ASRock Polychrome, Corsair, Razer, Logitech, SteelSeries and over a thousand more devices. Network lamps and LED controllers (E1.31, DDP, LIFX, Yeelight, Govee, Elgato, WiZ) and Arduino LED strips can be added by hand in LiFaCo.
plugins.author: LiFaCo

plugins.name: Virtual devices
plugins.description: Pretend LED devices without any hardware. Good for trying out effects, for tests and as a minimal example plugin.
plugins.author: LiFaCo

plugins.name: WLED
plugins.description: LED strips and matrices running WLED (ESP32/ESP8266). Use WLED's 100+ built-in effects or let LiFaCo draw its own effects, for example a colour that follows the CPU temperature.
plugins.author: LiFaCo
